prompt: A regal high priestess in flowing bone-white and gold-trimmed robes, a tall mitre headdress, standing facing the viewer with both hands raised, cupped, radiating a warm golden healing light that streams outward. Around and below her, two hooded acolyte clerics kneel in reverence, faces lit by her glow. The only source of light is the priestess's golden radiance. The background is the dim stone interior of a candlelit cathedral with tall arched windows.

Close-up portrait of a serene older high priestess, wine-purple and bone-white vestments with gold embroidery, a jeweled circlet on her brow, eyes closed in prayer. She holds a small glowing sphere of soft white healing light cupped in both hands at her chest, the light haloing her face. The only source of light is the sphere's glow. The background is deep shadow with faint stained-glass color behind her.

A high priestess enthroned on a stone altar-throne in a candlelit shrine, wearing layered gold-and-ivory ceremonial robes and a tall ornate mitre. Three robed clerics climb the steps toward her, the foremost kneeling, and a thread of golden life-light flows from each cleric up toward the priestess's outstretched hand. Dozens of votive candles light the scene warmly. The background is a vaulted gothic cathedral apse in deep shadow.

A high priestess in profile, three-quarter view, draped in ivory and gold ceremonial robes with a long embroidered stole, one hand pressed to her chest where a warm golden glow of gathered life-energy blooms. A line of hooded acolyte clerics processes toward her from the right, each emitting a faint mote of golden light that drifts to her. Warm candle glow. The background is a dim stone abbey hall with tall pillars.

Stern matriarch high priestess, weathered face, silver hair under a bone-white wimple and gold diadem, full-length crimson-lined white robes. She stands at the head of a stone sanctuary, arms spread protectively over two small kneeling clerics, golden healing radiance pouring from her open palms over them. The only source of light is her golden glow. The background is a shadowed cathedral nave with stained-glass windows.

Overhead three-quarter view of a high priestess at a marble altar, arms lifted, a sphere of brilliant white-gold healing light suspended above her cupped hands. Robed clerics encircle the altar, kneeling, their upturned faces lit gold. Votive candles ring the floor. The background is the dark vaulted interior of a temple, faint cerulean stained glass behind.

A high priestess silhouette standing at the top of cathedral steps, arms outstretched, robed in white and gold, crowned with a tall mitre, a brilliant golden halo of healing light blazing behind her head and shoulders. Below her a crowd of small kneeling clerics in hooded robes is bathed in her light. The only source of light is her golden radiance. The background is a darkened gothic cathedral with rose windows.

Tight waist-up portrait of a high priestess, young and resolute, sapphire eyes, ivory robe with gold-thread sun emblem on the chest, an ornate winged headdress. She presses one palm forward toward the viewer, a soft golden glyph of healing light glowing in her hand. Faint motes of golden light drift in from the edges as if summoned to her. The background is a shadowed sanctuary with warm candlelight.

A high priestess kneeling at a glowing altar in prayer, golden-white robes pooling around her, gold mitre set beside her, both hands clasped as a column of warm golden healing light descends from above onto her. Two acolyte clerics stand behind holding candles. The only source of light is the descending golden beam and the candles. The background is a dim stone chapel with a tall arched window.

Wide shot of a high priestess at the center of a circular shrine, standing tall in cream and gold vestments and a tall mitre, both arms raised, golden healing radiance bursting outward in a ring. Around her, four hooded clerics kneel evenly spaced, each lit gold. Floor candles everywhere. The background is the dark domed interior of a temple with cerulean stained glass.
